column1: # The codebases scripts/parse-corpus.sh parses: every .qc and .qh file under `directory` in
# the source. Codebase ids are those of corpus/manifest.toml in quakecstudio/editor.
# `strict` codebases must parse with no ERROR or MISSING node; a file of another codebase may
# instead be listed in not-covered.tsv, with the construct this grammar does not cover.
